body:
This PR updates security-critical dependencies addressing authentication and data parsing vulnerabilities.

**Authentication Security:**
- github.com/coreos/go-oidc: v2.3.0 -> v2.4.0
  - Security fix: Now verifies token signature BEFORE validating payload
  - Prevents potential processing of tampered tokens before cryptographic verification

- github.com/cyphar/filepath-securejoin: v0.6.0 -> v0.6.1
  - Security fix: Fixed seccomp fallback logic - library now properly falls back to safer O_PATH resolver when openat2(2) is denied by seccomp-bpf
  - Fixed file descriptor leak in openat2 wrapper during RESOLVE_IN_ROOT

- cyphar.com/go-pathrs: v0.2.1 -> v0.2.2
  - Companion update to filepath-securejoin

**Protobuf Security:**
- google.golang.org/protobuf: v1.36.8 -> v1.36.11
  - Security fix: Added recursion limit check in lazy decoding validation
  - Prevents potential stack exhaustion attacks via maliciously crafted protobuf messages
  - Also adds support for URL chars in type URLs in text-format

- golang.org/x/crypto: v0.45.0 -> v0.46.0

- golang.org/x/tools: v0.38.0 -> v0.40.0
- golang.org/x/exp: 8a7402abbf56 -> 944ab1f22d93

Security & Stability:
- x/crypto: Updated X509 root certificate bundle
- x/net: HTTP/2 PING optimization to reduce DoS detection triggers, data race fix in trace RenderEvents
- x/sys: Fixed out-of-bounds memory access in sockaddrIUCVToAny
- x/time: Fixed rate limiter overflow when using very low rates that could cause the limiter to jam open

Performance:
- x/time: ~19% improvement in Sometimes.Do when no interval configured

Maintenance:
- Various vet diagnostic fixes for Go 1.26 compatibility
- Dependency updates across the golang.org/x ecosystem

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

This PR fixes a critical gap in the In-Place Pod Vertical Scaling feature where the allocatedResources field in the Pod status was being reported as nil or mismatched during resize operations.

This issue was particularly prevalent for Guaranteed QoS pods. When a resize request is processed, the Kubelet updates the underlying cgroups, but the status_manager was failing to synchronize the newly admitted resource values back to the API server. By ensuring allocatedResources is correctly populated, we prevent the Scheduler from seeing stale or null resource data, which could otherwise lead to node over-commitment.

Key Changes:

pkg/kubelet/cm/container_manager_linux.go: Updated UpdateAllocatedResourcesStatus to explicitly include CPU and Memory requests in the AllocatedResources status map when the InPlacePodVerticalScaling feature gate is enabled.

pkg/kubelet/status/status_manager.go: Modified updateStatusInternal to ensure that allocatedResources are preserved during status normalization and correctly synchronized from the Kubelet's internal admitted state to the v1.PodStatus.

#### Which issue(s) this PR is related to:
Fixes #136078

The failure was identified in the alpha E2E test suite where pod.status.allocatedResources returned a mismatch error.

Reviewers should note that the logic in status_manager.go now acts as a safeguard to ensure that even if a container runtime does not immediately report the new allocation, the Kubelet's authoritative admitted state (from the Spec) is used to populate the status. This maintains consistency for the Scheduler and other controllers.

body:
### What happened?

[The Kubernetes CRD API reference documentation for JSONSchemaProps](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/kubernetes-api/extend-resources/custom-resource-definition-v1/#JSONSchemaProps) contains a broken link.

> JSONSchemaProps is a JSON-Schema following Specification Draft 4 (http://json-schema.org/).

The URL to json-schema.org includes a trailing `)` character, resulting in `http://json-schema.org/)` which returns a 404 error. When rendered on the website, the closing parenthesis is incorrectly included as part of the URL.

### What did you expect to happen?

The link should point to https://json-schema.org/ (without the trailing parenthesis) and load successfully.

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

1. Navigate to the [The Kubernetes CRD API reference documentation for JSONSchemaProps](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/kubernetes-api/extend-resources/custom-resource-definition-v1/#JSONSchemaProps)
2. Click on the json-schema.org link in the description
3. The URL includes ) and fails to load


### Anything else we need to know?

While it may be possible to fix this in the [reference-docs generator](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/reference-docs), the most straightforward solution is to fix the source comment in k/k apiextensions-apiserver.
Since the URL also needs to be updated from http to https, fixing the source comment addresses both issues at once and is the most appropriate approach.

https://github.com/kubernetes/website/issues/53971
